component.name: Meguri
component.summary: Browse, search, and play your local videos and photos

description.p: Meguri is a local-first media library for your videos and photos. Point it at any folder and it builds a fast, searchable catalog of everything inside — thumbnails, metadata, tags, and ratings — all stored locally. No account, no cloud, no uploads.

ul.li: Grid, list, and table layouts with smooth virtualized scrolling
Automatic thumbnails for both videos and images
Full-text search plus filters for type, rating, tags, and capture date
Built-in player with scene previews and scene bookmarks
Manual tags with autocomplete and star ratings that survive file moves
Discovery mode that resurfaces random finds from your library
A dozen base16 color themes (gruvbox, nord, solarized, dracula, and more)

description.p: Meguri never modifies your media files: it only reads the folders you choose and keeps its own data separately.
